capability: Conjugate heat transfer across fluid/solid interfaces

quantity.name: fully developed parallel-plate Nusselt number
quantity.observable: Nu = q'' D_h / (k (T_w - T_b)) evaluated in the thermally developed region. q'' = 1 is the applied outer flux, exact by conservation, rather than a differentiated field. T_b is the mixing-cup average integral(u T)/integral(u) across the channel and T_w is the mean interface temperature at the same axial station.
quantity.supersedes: The previous row used D_h = 2 and a channel in which the flow was not thermally developed; its Nu drifted monotonically past 8.235 (8.376, 8.273, 8.201) rather than converging to it, so the reported 0.4% agreement was a crossing, not convergence.

reference.source: Fully developed laminar parallel-plate channel with both walls at constant heat flux: Nu=8.235; NASA NTRS heat-transfer notes, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/19920012099/downloads/19920012099.pdf
reference.derivation: Classical Graetz solution; constant-q'' parallel plates, not constant-temperature (7.541) or circular-pipe values
reference.confirmed_from: NASA NTRS discussion of the parallel-plate constant-heat-flux definition

tolerance.rationale: Declared before the flowing-channel solve; the coarse diagnostic remains PARTIAL until refinement and exact flux extraction are added.

convergence.note: Interface heat-flux continuity and the energy balance are reported as invariants alongside the Nusselt error.

mesh_level_correction.what_was_wrong: The declared coarse level nx=11 gives dx=0.2 on a 2.2-wide domain, so the fluid/solid interfaces at x=0.1 and x=2.1 do not fall on element boundaries and the subdomain cannot be represented. That run aborted.
mesh_level_correction.what_changed: nx must be a multiple of 22 for the 0.1-thick wall to be meshed. Levels are 22, 44, 88. No tolerance was altered.
mesh_level_correction.recorded: 2026-08-03, after the abort and before the replacement level was used

parameters.hydraulic_diameter_derivation: D_h = 4A/P with A = spacing x depth and P = 2 x depth for two plates, giving D_h = 2 x spacing = 4. The earlier implementation used D_h = 2, the spacing itself, which is a factor of two low.

energy_balance.metric: relative difference between the measured mixing-cup dT_b/dy and 2 q''/(rho cp mdot)
energy_balance.rationale: Declared before the runs. If the bulk temperature does not rise at the rate the applied flux demands, no Nusselt number extracted from it means anything.

thermal_development.metric: relative variation of T_w - T_b across the developed window, max-min over mean
thermal_development.rationale: Constant q'' developed flow requires T_w - T_b to be constant. This is the check the old geometry failed by 50%.

interface_flux_continuity.metric: relative mismatch between the solid-side and fluid-side interface flux integrals

developed_window.rationale: Fixed before the runs: past the thermal entry length of about 3.1 and clear of the outlet boundary.
